protocol.question: Does the same marker arrangement experience different future deformation under opposite present fluid velocity fields?
protocol.event_threshold_source: Frozen original training 90th-percentile threshold for duration-.2 FTLE; not recalibrated on either intervention branch. Used only at the .2 primary horizon.
protocol.intervention: Clone the same full Fourier fluid field and marker positions at t=.3. Continue one with +u and the other with -u, evolving forward using the unchanged parent Flow, zero forcing, same positive viscosity, periodic domain L=6, mean zero and joint Heun marker/tangent update. Reset tangent basis to identity at branch time. Velocity reversal changes the full gradient and strain sign; this is not a matched-present-gradient history intervention.
protocol.reconstruction: Original prediction archives have positions/gradients/tangents but no full Eulerian field checkpoint. Reconstruct each .3 state by an explicitly recorded deterministic replay from its original smooth initial condition. Validate replayed positions, velocities and gradients against existing archived .3 samples before branching; validate + branch against archived .3 to .5 trajectory and relative tangent target. Do not rerun the original long matrix or modify any original numerical source.
protocol.primary_metrics: Per-run same-label RMSE and correlation between forward FTLEs of the two branches; signed mean difference; fixed-threshold event disagreement and Jaccard at .2; return-path discrepancy between - branch at elapsed tau and archived x(.3-tau). Map initial label locations, not future Eulerian event onset locations.
protocol.geometry: At branch instant use same kNN offsets. Record neighbor-pair logarithmic separation rates from relative velocities, linearized directional strain along each offset, and strain along largest covariance axis. These signed rates must negate under u -> -u; squared alignment alone cannot distinguish approach/separation.
protocol.resolution: Compare same seed/label branch targets across 38 and 56 grids, then compare the change of the branch contrast. Only one finest-grid timestep control and two grids: no established spatial convergence. Four independent seeds are a descriptive pilot, not a new predictive training/test set.
protocol.checks: Pilot first: seed1024 grid38 both branches. Require archive match max position/velocity/gradient error <1e-10, + target error <1e-9, finite states, CFL<.5, spectral divergence<1e-10, energy budget relative error<.005. Preserve failed checkpoints and stop on material failures. No automatic matrix expansion.
protocol.scope: 9 state reconstructions and 18 short branches total. Normal branches reproduce saved evolution as controls. No predictor refits, no repeat of original history or mirror studies, no molecular model, no proof of material memory or a particular causal marker arrangement. Passive marker geometry does not exert forces.
